title: NATO STANAG Homologation Defense Bid Deviations & Exceptions
description: Upper-intermediate commercial and defense sales module analyzing nato stanag homologation defense bid deviations & exceptions.
learning_objectives: Master professional Subjunctive in Contractual Deviations in technical sales and export contracts
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in nato stanag homologation defense bid deviations & exceptions
Demonstrate mastery in international negotiations and Incoterms documentation

questions.prompt: The defense tender evaluation committee stipulated that Tatra _____ an irrevocable warranty bond for 5% of the total contract value.

explanations.correct: B2 commercial negotiation syntax: Mandative subjunctive after 'stipulated that' requires base form 'furnish'.
explanations.wrong_A: Option 'furnishes' fails to apply the required inversion or subjunctive base form.
explanations.wrong_C: Option 'shall furnish' is grammatically inappropriate for this formal commercial context.
explanations.wrong_D: Option 'must to furnish' is ungrammatical in standard business English.

questions.cz_learning_point: High-stakes commercial tenders prioritize formal subjunctive ('insisted that it be capped') and negative inversion ('Rarely does a buyer agree').

questions.prompt: Rarely _____ an international buyer agree to 100% advance payment without demanding a standby letter of credit.

explanations.correct: B2 commercial negotiation syntax: Negative restrictive 'Rarely' triggers auxiliary inversion: 'Rarely does an international buyer agree'.
explanations.wrong_A: Option 'is' fails to apply the required inversion or subjunctive base form.
explanations.wrong_B: Option 'will' is grammatically inappropriate for this formal commercial context.
explanations.wrong_D: Option 'has' is ungrammatical in standard business English.

explanations.wrong_D: Option 'shall our sales executives to' is ungrammatical in standard business English.
